summary_rationale: AvePoint has executed a multi-year transition from legacy on-premises SharePoint tools into an 80% SaaS cloud data protection and AI governance platform ($495.1M ARR in Q3 2026, +25% FX-adjusted), combining 111% FX-adjusted net retention, 90% gross retention, expanding GAAP operating margins (10% TTM), ~19-20% free cash flow margins, and a debt-free $418.3M cash balance sheet that funded $142M of share repurchases in 9M 2026. Key watch items are >90% Microsoft ecosystem concentration, services gross margin drag (72.8% consolidated Non-GAAP GM in Q3 2026), and 2026 investment-year compression in Non-GAAP operating margin.
